cues.text: The summer festival at Naganaki Shrine, lined with stalls and crowded with people. You arrive with Mitsuru and Aigis, and Aigis wanders a few steps ahead, looking around.
Aigis turns and heads straight for a takoyaki stall, where a vendor is cooking. You and Mitsuru follow her.
Moments later, standing off to one side of the stall, Aigis eats takoyaki from a tray in her hands.
The three of you move on to a stall selling masks.
Further along, you come to a lucky-draw stall, where a man stands behind a counter with a box on it.
You step up to the counter, reach into the box and draw one out.
